CORPORATE HOLDINGS REGISTER
Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.
Prairie owns 50.00% of Umber.
Onyx owns 50.00% of Umber.
Delta owns 75.00% of Prairie.

CORPORATE HOLDINGS REGISTER
Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.

CORPORATE HOLDINGS REGISTER
Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.

Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.

CORPORATE HOLDINGS REGISTER
Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.

Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.

Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. CORPORATE HOLDINGS REGISTER
Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.

CORPORATE HOLDINGS REGISTER
Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.

controller.instructions: Who is the ultimate controller of Fjord?
controller.label: c

interest.instructions: What is Kestrel's economic interest in Fjord? Round to two decimal places.
interest.label: e

state:
CORPORATE HOLDINGS REGISTER
Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.
Yarrow owns 65.00% of Fjord.
Kestrel owns 60.00% of Alder.
Alder owns 35.00% of Fjord.

CORPORATE HOLDINGS REGISTER
Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.
Delta owns 65.00% of Beryl.
Onyx owns 50.00% of Delta.

state:
CORPORATE HOLDINGS REGISTER
Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.
